calculateSignPrice.name: Calculate Sign Price
calculateSignPrice.description: Write a function that calculates the price of a sign. Each letter costs $12. Spaces are free and should not be counted. Return the result as a formatted string.

whatCounting.question: What am I actually counting?
whatCounting.answer: Letters. Specifically, anything that isn't a space. So you want a counter that goes up for each non-space character in the sign text.

loopCharacters.question: How do I loop through the characters?
loopCharacters.answer: A `for...of` loop gives you each character in turn, so you can look at them one at a time.

checkSpace.question: How do I check whether a character is a space?
checkSpace.answer: Inside the loop, use an if-statement to compare the character against `" "`. Only count the character when it isn't a space.

buildResultString.question: How do I build the result string?
buildResultString.answer: Use string concatenation or template strings. Check the concepts if you need a reminder on these.
